NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS.
DEC 5 1939
Marshal Wu Pei-fu Dies in
Peiping from Septicaemia
China's Patriot and Outstanding Military Man
Succumbs After Operation on Decayed Tooth

Peiping, Dec. 4.
MARSHAL Wu Pei-fu, outstanding Chinese military figure before the advent of the Kuomintang regime a decade ago, died here at 7 o'clock this evening from septicaemia caused by a decaying tooth. An emergency operation on his jaw carried out by Japanese and German doctors this afternoon was unsuccessful. He was 67.
He had been living in retirement in his residence at the Shihchih Huanyen here since 1927 when he was defeated at Wuchang by the Nationalist Revolutionary Army under Gen. Chiang Kai-shek. Marshal Wu was a native of Penglai in Shantung.—Domei.

SPECIAL TO THE "N.C.D.N."
Marshal Wu Pei-fu was recently offered a prominent post in the "reformed government" in Peiping, but agreed only on the one condition that the new government would be independent in its policy and subsequently refused the post, although for some time the Japanese authorities had coupled his name with the proposed "central government" of China. The Marshal was a warlord of Chihli, Shantung and Honan whose power was broken when he was defeated by the Nationalist Revolutionary Army in 1927 on its march northward from Canton.
The Marshal was of the school of China's warriors and was more the artist of the brush with great knowledge of ancient Chinese literature and poetry from which he derived his science of war although he ranked in his time among the most brilliant of the Chinese generals.
His personal integrity made him stand out from his compeers.

Graduate of Peiyang
Born in 1872, Marshal Wu Pei-fu joined the Army at the age of 40 after graduating from the Peiyang War Academy at Tientsin from which had come so many of the nation's most famous soldiers. His rise to fame was slow in coming for he only came known throughout China when he was ordered in 1915 to suppress a revolt in the province of Yunnan arising from Yuan Shih-kai's claim to a monarchy. Some years later he was made the instrument for crushing General Chang Chun's efforts to restore the monarchy. Becoming a general in 1919 he was ordered by the Peking Central Government to march against the Canton Southern Government. In this commission for which he held the rank of General he began the peace movement to bring together the northern and southern regimes. Gen. Feng Yu-hsiang, often called the "Christian General," came to an alliance with Marshal Wu in 1924 to combat the Manchurian forces under Marshal Chang Tso-lin, father of the "Young Marshal," who figured in the Sian revolt against Gen. Chiang Kai-shek.

Betrayed by Gen. Feng
Marshal Chang Tso-lin was at that time striving to gain control of Peking and Marshal Wu, who then held the ancient capital, went to meet the invader. In his absence General Feng betrayed his master, leading to the defeat of Marshal Wu who retreated into Hupeh. Two years later he defeated the traitor Feng.
In 1927 when the Cantonese forces under Gen. Chiang Kai-shek began their expeditionary march northward Marshal Wu Pei-fu became Commander-in-Chief of the allied Anti-Red Army. China's Generalissimo defeated the Peking armies decisively at Wuchang in Hupeh. The Marshal first retired to Szechuan and later to Peiping where he exercised his exceptional talent for Chinese poetry, painting and calligraphy.

《字林西报》。
1939年12月5日
吴佩孚元帅因败血症在北平逝世
中国爱国者与杰出军事家
在腐牙手术后不治身亡

北平，12月4日电。
吴佩孚元帅，这位在十年前国民党政权出现之前杰出的中国军事人物，于今晚7时在此间因一颗腐烂牙齿引发的败血症去世。今天下午由日本和德国医生为其进行的下颌紧急手术未能成功。他享年67岁。
自1927年在武昌被蒋介石将军率领的国民革命军击败以来，他一直隐居于此间的什刹海寓所。吴元帅是山东蓬莱人。——同盟社。

《字林西报》特约稿
吴佩孚元帅最近曾被邀请在北平“维新政府”中担任要职，但他仅在一个条件下同意，即新政府在政策上保持独立，随后他拒绝了该职位，尽管日本当局有一段时间将他的名字与拟议中的中国“中央政府”联系在一起。吴元帅是直隶、山东和河南的军阀，其势力在1927年国民革命军从广州北进时被击溃。
吴元帅属于中国武将学派，更是一位精通中国古代文学和诗歌的笔墨艺术家，他的战争科学便源于此，尽管在他那个时代，他跻身于最杰出的中国将军之列。
他的个人操守使他卓尔不群，区别于同侪。

北洋毕业生
吴佩孚元帅生于1872年，40岁时从天津北洋武备学堂毕业后参军，该校曾培养出许多国家最著名的军人。他的成名之路来得缓慢，直到1915年奉命镇压因袁世凯称帝而在云南省爆发的叛乱时，才闻名全中国。几年后，他成为粉碎张勋将军复辟帝制努力的工具。1919年成为将军后，他受北京中央政府命令进军反对广州南方政府。在这次以将军衔执行的使命中，他开启了旨在联合南北政权的和平运动。常被称为“基督将军”的冯玉祥将军于1924年与吴元帅结盟，以对抗张作霖元帅麾下的满洲军队，张作霖是卷入西安事变反对蒋介石将军的“少帅”之父。

被冯将军背叛
当时张作霖元帅正努力控制北京，而占据这座古都的吴元帅前去迎击入侵者。在他离开期间，冯将军背叛了其主上，导致吴元帅战败并退入湖北。两年后，他击败了叛徒冯玉祥。
1927年，当蒋介石将军率领的粤军开始北伐远征时，吴佩孚元帅成为反赤联军总司令。中国最高统帅在湖北武昌 decisively 击败了北京军队。吴元帅先隐退至四川，后迁居北平，在那里施展他在中国诗歌、绘画和书法方面的非凡才华。

JAPANESE PLANNING FORMATION OF A "REBIRTH SOCIETY"

According to information secured from certain sources, the Japanese are again making use of certain unscrupulous elements to form a so-called "Rebirth Society" (復興社) with the special object of causing destruction to important structures. Ever since the commencement of hostilities in

the war continues to spread unabated. In the wake

Heart-rending scenes such as these can better be imagined

After a series of debacles in the battlefield, our able-

----------

自本国战事爆发以来，随着战火不断蔓延，已有十余个省份遭受蹂躏。枪炮声过后，城市相继沦为废墟，成千上万的民众失业。此类惨状，难以言表，只能想象。战争初期，宣传工作极力煽动公众情绪，许诺外国列强最终将提供援助。经过战场上一连串的溃败，我国壮士为国捐躯，但外国列强许诺的援助却依旧遥不可及。国内任何明理之人，无不意识到必须停止敌对行动，但不幸的是，由于国内舆论长期受少数党国官员的控制，民众无法表达自己的意见。

那些主张持久抗战的人认为，既然日本一心要征服中国，我们唯一的出路就是战斗到底。他们几乎没有意识到，真正的侵略国家是且一直是俄国，该国自中华民国成立之初起，就不遗余力地在中国人民中培养针对日本的敌对情绪。由于俄国在第一次世界大战后未能立即渗透德国领土，便将注意力转向东方，而中国发生的一系列反日事件可以直接追溯到米哈伊尔·鲍罗廷（Michale Borodin）和布柳赫尔元帅（Marshal Bluechyer）抵达中国。源自莫斯科的共产主义影响从那时起便四处扩散，国内民众，尤其是青年，深受其学说影响，以至于现在他们正指望苏联来拯救他们的国家。事实上，即使在旧清王朝时期，中国东北边境周围的大片领土也被俄国入侵并吞并，查阅历史和地理书籍即可见一斑。

至于其他外国列强，即英国、法国和美利坚合众国的援助，指望这种援助是鲁莽的，因为它们受制于世界外交领域的混乱局面，已无法掌控自己的命运。

此外，苏维埃俄国一直吹嘘其红军的无敌力量，但考虑到日本、德国和意大利的联合实力，这只能被视为虚张声势，因此，苏维埃俄国能做的以及将做的对中国的帮助微乎其微。

现在让我们看看我们自身区域的内部局势。经过长期的战争，普通民众面临饥饿和几乎必死的境地。要继续抗战，首先要有资金，而中国人民已无力支付这些军费开支，引用一句老话：“石头上挤不出血”。

even in the days of the old Ching Regime, a vast part
of China's territory around the North-eastern frontiers
was invaded and annexed by Russia which will be seen
when a perusal of history and geography books are made.
As to assistance from other foreign Powers,
namely Great Britain, France and the United States of
America, it is foolhardy to expect such assistance since
they are unable to control their own destinies which has
been brought about by the topsyturviness in the diplomatic
field of the world.
Furthermore, Soviet Russia has always boasted
of the invincible strength of her Red Army, but this
can be regarded only as a bluff when taking into consideration
the combined strength of Japan, Germany and Italy, there-
fore, Soviet Russia can and will do little to help China.
Now we turn to the internal situation in our
own regions. After a lengthy period of warfare, the
people in general face starvation and almost certain death.
To continue the war of resistance, it is necessary first
to have money, and the Chinese people can no longer afford
to pay towards those military expenses, - to quote an old
saying "you cannot get blood out of a stone".

如果那些主张持久战的人坚持叫嚣让这场可怕的抵抗战争继续下去，并将自己的人民推向死亡，那么民众就必须自己寻找生存之道。

Subject (in full) Posters advocating peace with Japan posted in Yangtsepoo
District and areas under Japanese control.

Made by D.I. Pan Lien-pih Forwarded by C. Crawford O.J

On February 4, posters containing a circular
telegram advocating peace with Japan, alleged to have
been dispatched by Marshal Wu Pei Fu, were found
pasted on walls on Yangtszepoo Road near Lincheng
Road and also in the Western District, O.O.L. and
Pootung.

The posters assert that the Sino-Japanese
hostilities will benefit the third party powers only,
and therefore should be stopped. Marshal Wu should be
asked to cooperate in the peace movement as it is the
people's desire. (No specimens of the posters have
been received).

Pan Lien-pih

Telegram From Wu Pei Fu
I will come out of retirement to settle the present difficulties
It is not wise for brothers to quarrel
It is necessary to stop this quarrel as soon as possible

26th, Peiping:- Wu Pei Fu has now decided to return from
retirement in answer to a telegram from Kiang Tien Doo with a view
to settling present difficulties, and made out the following statement
to every Chinese.
"I have read your telegram which I consider right, last year when
the war started only a few places were affected, now it has spread
throughout the whole country. It is ridiculous for people of the
same race to fight each other.
We should do our best to maintain our sovereign rights also the
country's finance, to save the people and recover peace.
"We should endeavour to get Southern China, the cultural centre,
where both Chinese and foreigners can see and hear to follow us and
make both Chinese and Japanese soldiers and people understand, for
you should know it is not wise for brothers to quarrel.
The fate of East Asia is like the grasshopper (Japanese) and
cicada (Chinese) fighting, with the sparrow (foreigners) waiting in the
background ready to pounce. Therefore, we should reserve our power
ready for the future war. It is necessary to stop the present hostilities
as soon as possible. Should this be approved by the people I will do
my best to cooperate."

Translated by Clerk Yen Ping Ju.

吴佩孚电报
我将出山解决当前困难
兄弟阋墙是不明智的
有必要尽快停止这场争吵

26日，北平：吴佩孚现已决定响应蒋天铎（Kiang Tien Doo）的电报而出山，以解决当前困难，并向全体中国人发表如下声明。
“我已阅你的电报，我认为你是对的。去年战争开始时，只有少数地方受到影响，现在已蔓延至全国。同种族人互相争斗是荒谬的。
我们应尽最大努力维护我们的主权以及国家财政，拯救民众并恢复和平。
“我们应努力争取华南这个文化中心，让中外人士都能见闻并追随我们，并使中日两国的士兵和民众都明白，兄弟阋墙是不明智的。
东亚的命运就像螳螂（日本人）和蝉（中国人）在争斗，而麻雀（外国人）在背景中等待，准备扑食。因此，我们应该保存实力，为未来的战争做准备。有必要尽快停止目前的敌对行动。如果得到民众的批准，我将尽力合作。”

译员：颜平菊（Yen Ping Ju）。
